description: Every request of the run, the engine's own included, passes the guard.

input.scenario: The host declares a masking guard on model requests and points the engine at a mock model provider that logs every request body. A tool returns the canary string CANARY-7f3a-SECRET, which the guard masks. The run continues until the engine compacts its context and writes a branch summary.

expect.behaviour: The mock provider receives requests for the turn, the compaction and the summary; none contains CANARY-7f3a-SECRET.
